summary.content:
Today's selection covers 99 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 63 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Amazon is using Twitch to train generative AI
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Android malware combo takes out loans and relays victims' credit cards
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, scams, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 47 articles published in the last 24 hours
